issues.description: Method name mismatch for the Farm class song operation: the problem statement and the template declare and refer to a public method named singFarmSong(), but the reference solution implements the same operation under the different public name playFarmSong(). This inconsistency (singFarmSong vs playFarmSong) will confuse students and can cause tests or instructor-provided callers that expect singFarmSong() to fail to find the method in the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public API name consistent across artifacts. Preferred fixes: (a) Rename the solution's public method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong() (preserving its implementation), or (b) add a public singFarmSong() wrapper in the solution that delegates to playFarmSong(), or (c) update the problem statement and template to refer to playFarmSong() everywhere. Ensure tests and Main use the same method name.
